property_summary: For any caller who locked a guess and waited until block.number > lockedBlock, calling settle never decreases the contract balance unless the stored guess is equal to the derived answer; the mutant pays out when the guess is wrong, so there exist inputs (a stored guess != answer) that make address(c).balance drop in the mutant but not in the reference.
change_summary: Change the equality check to inequality so payment occurs when the guess is wrong, altering which calls succeed without revert.
